title: Inheritance
description: A Modpack focused on having fun playing, and of the Series Minecraft: Inheritance
body:
This Modpack is for one single purpose: Having fun playing modded Minecraft together with your friends. When i made this, i focused on finding Mods to enhance visuals, give more building blocks, new combat mechanics by using Epic Fight's combat system, and new Worldgen to make new landscapes.

Why would you want to download this Pack?
- Perfect for multiplayer fun – Designed for playing with friends.
- Stunning visuals – Iris + Sodium for smooth, beautiful shaders.
- More building options – Biomes O’ Plenty, Better End/Nether, and WorldWeaver for -   endless creativity.
- Dynamic combat – Epic Fight’s system for skill-based battles.
- Optimized performance – FerriteCore, Lithium, and EntityCulling for lag-free gameplay.
- Quality-of-life improvements – AppleSkin, Shulker Box Tooltip, and Better Recipe Book.
- Easy customization – Mod Menu and Cloth Config for simple tweaks.
- Quick-access tools – BackSlot for extra inventory convenience.


This is Minecraft: Inheritance
